rules: Verification rule of the Depth datum plan (2026-11-22) section 3: a side is VERIFIED only when two independent publishers name the same datum for the same series or pool (or the datum is stamped by the series' own parameter definition AND an empirical cross-gauge check passes); a conversion is enabled only when the offset agrees with NOAA VDatum at the gauge within 0.10 ft; datum-name disagreement or offsets more than 0.25 ft apart is CONFLICT; at most two research passes per lake. Consumed by depth_research.candidates (verified_conversion); nothing here is read at runtime. Rules-2 (review of PR #223): two publishers that re-serve one upstream record count once (`derivedFrom` on each evidence item, distinct roots required); a side's own offset more than 0.25 ft from VDatum must be recorded as offsetConflict and blocks VERIFIED; every record above NONE needs an http evidence item; carried-forward pointers are marked notEvidence; a SAME_SOURCE record pins Lake's reviewed live binding and the pool Lake Brain uses. Rules-3 (Michael, chat 2026-11-22 08:11Z, recorded on Sector_Ops #51): VERIFIED_SINGLE_OFFICIAL, labelled 'single official source', permits the same use as VERIFIED when (a) every evidence root of the single-source side is an official authority (USGS, USACE, USBR, TVA, NOAA, or the dam operator named in damOperator), (b) an empirical real-data check agrees numerically (n >= 5, tolerance <= 0.30 ft, closer to the claimed offset than to no offset), and (c) the record sets singleOfficialSource=true and the label. Two independent roots (VERIFIED) stay the stronger tier.
reviewer: claude-code (research pass; promotion into a knowledge release is Michael's decision)

empirical.note: after the -0.2 ft conversion the two gauges agree within 0.3 ft on every sampled date (largest residual 0.15 ft); a mislabelled NGVD29 series would centre near 0, the NAVD88 label centres near -0.2 Mean -0.178 is 0.107 ft from VDatum's -0.285 and 0.022 ft from the -0.2 ft conversion; it is 0.178 ft from 'no offset', so the discrimination between NAVD88 and a mislabelled NGVD29 series is real but weak (0.107 vs 0.178 ft).
